name: Jika Tabi
description: Jika Tabi — a store theme for a split-toe tabi and jika-tabi work-boot maker, with WooCommerce templates styled to match. Tetsukon iron navy (#17184B) is the main colour: the header, the hero, the sticky making story, every page head, the bands and the footer are navy fields with washi-white type, kohaze-brass labels and vermilion numbers; New Tegomin for display and Lexend for reading. A centred giant-type hero sits over a full layered paper-cut illustration, with a vertical Japanese label at the edge and a cut-out boot that steps out over the hero into the next section; the menu always opens as a full-screen overlay. Below, a sticky-media story pins the paper-cut picture while the five making steps scroll past, then the tabi, the journal and the shop letter. All illustrations are generated in one layered paper-cut (kirie) style. The shop details and the cloth-and-care notes each live in one synced pattern (WooCommerce optional: without it the tabi show as static cells and orders go by email).
deviation: None: built exactly to design-plan.json row b3-17 (sticky-media, centered-giant-type hero, overlay nav, full-illustration images, paper-cut illustration, tetsukon #17184B, New Tegomin + Lexend). Every picture is a layered paper-cut raster illustration generated with Grok Build; the boot is also a transparent cut-out that steps out of the hero (break-frame). Contrast: washi white #EFEDE6 on tetsukon #17184B 14.1:1 (all text on the navy header, hero, sticky story, page heads, bands and footer); pale indigo #B4B8D6 on tetsukon 8.5:1; kohaze brass #D9B866 on tetsukon 8.7:1 (labels, buttons, vertical labels; tetsukon on brass buttons 8.7:1); vermilion #EC8266 on tetsukon 6.3:1 (numbers and emphasis); tetsukon on paper #F2F1EE 14.7:1; deep red links #9C2A1C on paper 6.7:1; quiet #4F5170 on paper 6.8:1; red #B83A2A on paper 5.1:1.
